title: Maximum Equal Adjacent Pairs After at Most One Replacement
statement: An integer array has length up to 10^5 and values up to 10^9. At most once, two distinct values x and y may be chosen and every x replaced with y, maximizing equal adjacent pairs. Replacement keeps existing equal pairs and creates new ones only where x and y are adjacent, so the gain is the most frequent unordered unequal adjacent value pair, counted with a hash map.
